newsitem.title: UK: FKI details Newman Tonks acceptances.
newsitem.headline: FKI details Newman Tonks acceptances.

text.p: British engineering group FKI Plc said on Monday it had received acceptances for around 20.6 percent of the issued ordinary share capital of British building products group Newman Tonks Plc.

FKI, now fighting against Ingersoll Rand Co for control of Newman Tonks, said it had in addition acquired 250,000 Newman Tonks shares and agreed to buy 250,000 shares representing around 0.4 percent of its total capital.
Ingersoll Rand announced its recommended cash offer for Newman Tonks earlier on Monday. It is offering 175p per share, which it said was worth 28.1 percent more than FKI's bid.
FKI launched its 195.7 million pound bid for Newman Tonks in December last year. Newman Tonks has urged its shareholders to reject the bid which has been extended to February 7.
Ingersoll, a U.S. manufacturer of air compressors, construction and mining equipment, said its bid values Newman Tonks at 230 million pounds.
